acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v49 token returned zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=48, projection digest=1e8ee149798e511246fe7a4152acb8dac4c72b13fc61db92ee587eaeef1d0843, and blob=36934b0ef0b844617ba68e91f0ac02ac98c9449f; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.projection_digest_rule: For v49, sha256(canonical_json_utf8(canonical_projection)); stored explicitly and recomputed after readback.
acceptance.slack_rule: After final v49 Git readback only, emit at most one sanitized version-advance pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v48, prior event digest 732c227a..., projection digest 1e8ee149..., and blob 36934b0e... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Vary recursive JSON object member order only. Keep values, UTF-8 encoding, whitespace, array order, numeric representation, idempotency strategy, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed.
experiment.hypothesis: Two JSON byte strings that differ only in object member order produce different raw SHA-256 digests but the same JCS-like NFC recursively sorted-key canonical bytes and canonical digest.
experiment.strongest_falsifier: Canonical outputs or digests differ; raw digests unexpectedly match; the proposed idempotency key or v49 Slack token already exists; task ID differs; CURRENT is not exact v48 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree; or Slack is posted before final Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: The canonicalizer is a locally implemented JCS-like routine over a specimen containing only strings, integers, arrays, and objects. It is not a conformance test of RFC 8785 number serialization, Unicode edge cases, duplicate-key parsing, or cross-language implementations. This wake isolates member order only and does not prove all semantically equivalent JSON serializations converge. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, duplicate searches, and Slack posting remain separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
canonical_transition.transaction_time_evidence: AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_CLOCK+GITHUB_COMMIT_METADATA; Git and Slack operations are not one transaction boundary
